pages.text: Runic Ink is made from diamonds, ink sacs, and glowstone dust. It can upgrade items up to $(legendary)Legendary$().
Nether Ink is made from quartz, nether wart, and Runic Ink. It can upgrade items up to $(mythic)Mythic$().
Ender Ink is made from ender pearls, purpur rods, and Nether Ink. It can upgrade items up to $(divine)Divine$().
